GovernedComputerRuntime enforces screen-bounds validation, per-session input budget, action rate limit, type-length cap, key allowlist. Six agent tools (status/screenshot/mouse_move/mouse_click/type_text/key_press) bridge through the external-tools surface behind executeCommand permission; input actions classify external/high → always-ask tier. Live verified: real 3600x1080 multi-monitor bounds, 6.6MB PNG capture hashed+persisted, SetCursorPos verified via OS GetCursorPos on two moves, SendInput keypress executed, all denials enforced.
